11. As aforementioned, the untenability in the staircases, lift lobbies, and corridors of Wang Fuk Court during the fire was a dynamic and evolving process.

12. Determining the exact timing of the conditions of these areas of the buildings, as outlined in Footnote 1, would require numerical precision and it is infeasible to do so for the reason given in paragraph 9 above. Nevertheless, a general estimation of when specific areas became unsafe for evacuation can be established based on available video footages and witness statements. With some analysis and tests, the time of onset of the conditions that impeded evacuation could then be estimated.

**Analysis**

13. The lift lobbies, corridors, and staircases were originally designed as protected escape routes. As mentioned in paragraph 4.1.5 of the Interim Report, one of the re-entrants is located immediately outside the lift lobby window, whereas another re-entrant is located immediately outside the staircase window.
